statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of the actual regional HTTP 403 notice delivered from the audit environment. The intended Finance templates and journeys were inaccessible, and that restriction is itself recorded as a critical core-task finding.

page.notes: The audit environment receives a static bilingual EEA/UK regional access notice with HTTP 403, not the intended Yahoo! Finance product. This is a single static surface with no JavaScript.

paths.description: Actual entry response and regional access notice. Represents the only reachable surface. Audited at desktop, 360 px mobile, dark, reduced-motion, and high-contrast preferences, plus no-JS crawler and static network/security/memory conditions. Not covered: intended Finance home, quote detail, portfolio, search, authentication, and transaction journeys because the origin returned the same geographic HTTP 403 policy page from this environment.

findings.summary: The Finance service is unavailable from the audit region.
findings.evidence: The main document returned HTTP 403 and rendered a geographic access notice stating that Yahoo! JAPAN services are unavailable in the EEA and UK. The intended finance content and journeys could not be reached.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a compliant regional Finance experience or a functional alternative that preserves the core market-information task. If access must remain restricted, expose a clearly scoped read-only fallback and machine-readable policy response.

findings.summary: The delivered notice does not honor the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is pixel-identical in appearance to the light capture; computed color-scheme is normal and no prefers-color-scheme rules were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare light and dark support with a color-scheme meta element and root property, then retint surfaces and text with light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme query.

findings.summary: Important browser security headers are missing.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN was present and transport used HTTPS.
findings.suggestedFix: Roll out a nonce or hash based CSP, HSTS, nosniff, a strict Referrer-Policy, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy. Keep clickjacking protection.

findings.evidence: The live viewport meta contains user-scalable=no. Axe classifies this as a critical meta-viewport violation, even though the 360 px layout itself has no horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and use width=device-width, initial-scale=1. Ensure the responsive layout remains usable at 200 to 400 percent zoom.

findings.summary: Document language and heading structure are invalid.
findings.evidence: The html element has no lang attribute, there is no h1, and heading order begins with h3 followed by h2. Axe reported html-has-lang and page-has-heading-one violations. The footer contentinfo landmark is nested inside main.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an appropriate document language, use one descriptive h1 followed by sequential headings, and move the footer outside main so landmarks are top-level.

findings.summary: Link colors miss WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: Axe identified 21 link/text nodes at approximately 4.04:1 to 4.17:1 against white, below the required 4.5:1 for normal text. No prefers-contrast or forced-colors adaptations were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken link colors to meet at least 4.5:1 and add forced-colors or prefers-contrast handling for custom colors.

findings.summary: The public Finance URL returns a 403 notice without clear indexing metadata.
findings.evidence: HAR and raw crawler fetch both returned HTTP 403. The document has no canonical, robots meta, hreflang, meta description, Open Graph metadata, or structured data. robots.txt and sitemap.xml requests returned the same 403 notice.
findings.suggestedFix: Return the intended successful public document where supported. For the regional denial page, explicitly set noindex and a canonical policy, and provide valid robots and sitemap responses rather than the generic notice.

findings.summary: A tiny static notice takes about 3 seconds to paint due to network and render-blocking delivery.
findings.evidence: Trace measured FCP and LCP at 3022 ms. HAR found five parser-inserted render-blocking stylesheets, with the document and styles taking roughly 1.25 seconds each. The main HTML was uncompressed.
findings.suggestedFix: Compress the HTML, inline the small critical styles for this notice, consolidate or defer noncritical CSS, and avoid loading the 19 KB icon font when no visible icon requires it.

findings.summary: The only image is oversized and lacks complete intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found a 1933 px PNG displayed at 170 px, with no srcset and no height attribute. It transfers 12,999 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Export a right-sized WebP or AVIF logo, provide responsive sources if needed, and set both width and height to reserve its aspect ratio.

findings.summary: Several text links have undersized touch hit areas.
findings.evidence: The live target probe found multiple links only 14 to 17 CSS pixels high, including footer and help links. Keyboard focus is visible, but touch target height is below modern accessible guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Give inline action links adequate line height and padding, with at least a 24 by 24 CSS pixel target and preferably 44 by 44 for primary mobile actions.

findings.summary: The bilingual page does not declare its base language or language changes.
findings.evidence: The html lang and dir attributes are empty while Japanese and English sections are both present. No lang attributes identify the English article, preventing reliable pronunciation and language-aware tooling.
findings.suggestedFix: Set html lang="ja" and lang="en" on the English article. Use logical CSS properties so both language and writing-mode changes remain robust.

findings.summary: The document has minor structural and asset hygiene problems.
findings.evidence: The page has a valid HTML5 doctype and UTF-8 charset, but the logo lacks a height attribute and stylesheet link elements are placed inside body/header after parsing has begun.
findings.suggestedFix: Move stylesheet links into head and provide complete image dimensions. Keep the valid doctype and charset.

taskList.title: Restore a compliant regional Finance experience or useful read-only fallback
Restore zoom and repair document language, headings, landmarks, and link contrast
Compress and simplify the critical rendering path
Define indexing policy and metadata for the regional response
Add user-preference theming and contrast adaptations
